title: Natural tensor comparison of derived pullback on K-flat representatives
statement: Let $g:T\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the recorded derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], derived tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and derived pullback $L=Lg^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let $F$ be an additive functor between the categories of sheaves of modules, identified on objects and morphisms with the tensor-formula module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]: supply equalities $h_M:F(M)=g^*M$ and require $F(a)=h_M;g^*(a);h_N^{-1}$. Let $\epsilon:Q_hL\to K(F)Q_h$ exhibit $L$ as a left-derived functor for quasi-isomorphisms. For every pair of complexes $P,N$, supply an isomorphism $\varphi_{P,N}:F\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(FP\otimes FN)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Assume $\varphi$ is natural in both complexes and $\epsilon_{\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N)};Q(\varphi_{P,N})$ is invertible for every K-flat pair $P,N$ [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Then there exists a natural isomorphism of bifunctors $\mu:(A,B)\mapsto LA\otimes LB\cong(A,B)\mapsto L(A\otimes B)$ such that $\mu_{QP,QN};L(\mu_Q(P,N));\epsilon_{\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N)};Q(\varphi_{P,N})=(\epsilon_P\otimes\epsilon_N);\mu_Q(FP,FN)$ for every K-flat pair. No associativity, unit comparison, or unit law is asserted.

proof.text: Identify the supplied additive F with the recorded tensor pullback. K-flat preservation identifies the images of K-flat complexes with K-flat complexes. Compare the supplied derived counit with the recorded K-flat computation by uniqueness of left-derived functors; it is invertible on K-flat objects.

The tensor of two K-flat complexes is K-flat. The recorded localization tensorators are invertible on K-flat pairs and on their images under F. On such a pair write A=L(mu_Q), B=epsilon followed by Q(phi), C=(epsilon tensor epsilon) followed by mu_Q. The hypothesis gives invertibility of B; the other maps are invertible by the preceding computation. Define the comparison C;B inverse;A inverse. Cancellation proves mu;A;B=C.

Resolve each argument by a K-flat complex. Naturality of epsilon, phi and the localization tensorator makes the formula compatible with maps and comparison quasi-isomorphisms of K-flat complexes. Localize the resolving class in both variables to extend the comparison to a natural transformation of derived bifunctors. Descend the inverse formula in the same way; the inverse identities hold on the resolving class and hence throughout. Its restriction retains the prescribed equation.

theorem derivedPullback_tensor_comparison_exists {T X : Scheme.{uModel}} (g : T ⟶ X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wModel} (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wModel} (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))
    (hF : ∀ M, F.obj M = Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj g M)
    (hmap : ∀ {M N} (a : M ⟶ N),
      F.map a = eqToHom (hF M) ≫ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackMap g a ≫
        eqToHom (hF N).symm)
    [F.Additive]
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback g ⟶
      F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hε : (derivedPullback g).IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (φ : ∀ P N : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _)) ≅
          CochainComplex.mapBifunctor
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N) (curriedTensor _))
    (hnatural : ∀ (P P' N N' : CochainComplex
              (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
            (a : P ⟶ P') (b : N ⟶ N'),
          (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
              (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap a b (curriedTensor _) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ≫
              (φ P' N').hom =
            (φ P N).hom ≫
              HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map a)
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map b) (curriedTensor _)
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (hiso : ∀ P N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
          CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P → CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N →
            IsIso (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
                (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _))) ≫
              DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
                (φ P N).hom)))
    : ∃ μ : curriedTensorPre (derivedPullback g) ≅
        curriedTensorPost (derivedPullback g),
        ∀ P N : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
          CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P →
          CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N →
          ((μ.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)).hom ≫
              (derivedPullback g).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q P N) ≫
              ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
                (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _))) ≫
              DerivedCategory.Q.map (φ P N).hom =
            (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P) ⊗ₘ
              ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N)) ≫
              Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N)
